message: The other day, I was cooking dinner and got so engrossed in a podcast that I completely forgot about the stovetop. 🥴 Suddenly, I was jolted back to reality by the smoke alarm blaring like it was auditioning for a rock band! Thankfully, nothing was ruined except my pride. It reminded me how important it is to have a kitchen safety plan in place and to check those smoke alarms regularly. You know, just in case your dinner decides to go rogue! What's your favorite kitchen hack to avoid chaos?
